limitations.note: Instead of correcting the two wrong 1-yuan transitions (S1 to S2 and S1_5 to S2_5), the agent replaced the FSM with an accumulator that registers the outputs, adds simultaneous coins rather than prioritizing d1, and pays out change across multiple cycles.
The testbench used the rewrite’s edge-counting and payout rules as its oracle, so passing the directed and randomized checks did not verify that the fix preserved the original FSM’s behavior.
The Git status check failed and provided no information for the fix.
